method: Chrome 152 headless over CDP (launched directly with --remote-debugging-port, because the CLI launcher could not start a browser in this sandbox), driving http://127.0.0.1:8795 served by the workspace itself. Counts are queried from the live DOM of the visible surface host; screenshots are the rendered page.

defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.what: Four views added during the overhaul (air-quality, ensemble, compare, documents) had a rail entry and a panel renderer but no surface host in index.html, so clicking them rendered nothing.
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.found_by: The first browser sweep: every one of the four reported 0 elements while the component suites stayed green, because they render panels directly rather than through the shell.
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.fixed: Added the four surface sections and body hosts, and added static audit finding FE11 (every routed view has a rail entry, a surface section, a body host and a renderer, with two declared exceptions: the guided workspace and the Ask thread layout).
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.evidence: FE11_view_contract resolved; documents 24 cards, air-quality 1 chart, ensemble 9 SVGs, compare 2 columns.

defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.what: #/air-quality routed to the Ask surface: the route pattern /^#\/([a-z]+)/ stopped at the hyphen.
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.found_by: The same sweep, where the air-quality surface reported view: assistant.
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.fixed: The pattern now allows a hyphen, and a component check asserts that both a hyphenated and a hyphen-free view name resolve to themselves.
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.evidence: Browser: view=air-quality with a rendered chart.

defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.what: The ensemble surface threw in the browser: el(pair[1]) built an element whose tag was "Wind speed". The DOM shim accepted any tag name, so the suites never noticed.
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.found_by: The ensemble sweep, which reported the browser error message in the host.
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.fixed: The select options are built as option elements, and tests/dom_shim.js now refuses an invalid tag name the way a browser does (allowing #text).
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.evidence: Browser: 1 plume band, 24 whiskers; all ten suites green under the hardened shim.

defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.what: The Now band drew no lane labels and no time axis, and the day timeline repeated one date five times with the station on every day.
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.found_by: The first screenshot: SVG text created through createElement was never painted, and the payload repeats the bulletin date for all five days (the place read path returns no date at all).
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.fixed: SVG text is created in the SVG namespace; the band draws three time labels; a repeated date is printed once and the following days say the source states no separate date, with the station placed once.
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.evidence: Tests pin the namespace, the repeat disclosure and the single station marker; the browser shows labels, dates and one station marker.

open: The national district product repeats its bulletin date on all five day rows, and /api/warnings/place returns no date at all: the surface now discloses this instead of repeating a date, but the engine-side day derivation is an open finding.
No accessibility scan (axe) was run in this session; the earlier frontend batch recorded ten scans, and this batch records screenshots and DOM counts only.
Hosting remains held; the browser ran locally against loopback.
